I'm sorry, but you wouldn't be eligible for a refund. Leafy Plus is fully refundable only if you cancel within 14 days of purchase or renewal and haven't used any benefits. You're within the 14 days (day 10), but using the free shipping counts as a benefit, so a refund isn't available.

If you cancel, you'd keep your benefits (free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, 90-day guarantee, and so on) until the end of your paid year. The policy excerpts I have don't say whether any exceptions are possible, so if you'd like to ask for one, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
